metadata.title: Secure Institutional Email Pattern (Component Definition)
metadata.remarks: Defines the composite architectural pattern for secure institutional email by requiring the coordinated application of core email, threat protection, data protection, identity, and records management patterns. This pattern expresses architectural composition and governance intent only.

components.title: Secure Institutional Email
components.description: Provides institutional email services that are secure, trustworthy, auditable, and compliant with legal, regulatory, and ethical obligations through the coordinated application of multiple architectural patterns.

links.text: Supports Communications Management (BC220) business capability in the Business Reference Model (BRM).

components.remarks: This capability represents the institutional definition of secure email. It is realized only when all required sub-patterns are implemented together.

dependencies.description: Core email transport and mailbox services
Protection against malicious, abusive, and deceptive email content
Protection of sensitive and regulated data within email (including AA-99 enforcement)
Identity binding, delegation, and accountability for email access
Records management, retention, legal hold, and discovery for email
